gloss: Golden Week; late-April to early-May holiday period

definitions.gloss: Golden Week; late-April to early-May holiday period
definitions.explanation: A cluster of national holidays from late April to early May, typically spanning April 29 through May 5. One of Japan's three major vacation periods alongside New Year and Obon.

examples.japanese: ゴールデンウィーク⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧？
examples.english: How many days is Golden Week?

examples.japanese: ゴールデンウィーク⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm planning to travel to Okinawa during Golden Week.

examples.japanese: ゴールデンウィーク⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{大渋滞|だいじゅうたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The highways get massively congested every year during Golden Week.

examples.english: Some people will get up to ten consecutive days off this Golden Week.

notes:
A Japanese-English hybrid term (⟦{和製英語|わせいえいご}→和製英語：18947_waseieigo⟧) referring to the cluster of national holidays from late April to early May. The name was coined by the film industry in the 1950s to promote cinema attendance during this period. Often abbreviated as GW in writing.

The holidays included in Golden Week are:
- April 29: ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Showa Day)
- May 3: {憲法記念日|けんぽうきねんび} (Constitution Memorial Day)
- May 4: みどり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Greenery Day)
- May 5: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Children's Day)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゴールデンウィーク⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during Golden Week
- ゴールデンウィーク⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧: after Golden Week ends
- ゴールデンウィーク⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: before Golden Week
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧ゴールデンウィーク: an extra-long Golden Week

CULTURAL NOTE:
Golden Week is one of Japan's busiest travel periods. Trains, flights, and hotels are heavily booked, and tourist spots are extremely crowded. Many companies close for the entire period, making it a rare opportunity for extended rest in Japanese work culture. NHK and some formal media use the term ⟦{大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう}→大型連休：14847_oogatarenkyuu⟧ ('extended consecutive holiday') instead, as ゴールデンウィーク originated as a commercial term.
